写工具，也写字I build tools, and I write

七个开源工具，外加四篇文章：一个 Flutter 的 Markdown 编辑器、一层 Agent 运行时、本地 Ollama 编码助手、OCR 的 MCP 服务、Windows 上的 JDK 切换器，还有这个站本身。Seven open-source tools and four essays — a Flutter Markdown editor, an agent runtime, a local Ollama coding harness, an OCR MCP server, a Windows JDK switcher, and this site.

关于About

关于这个站About this site

在本地跑模型、把意图编译成可回滚的执行链、用一行批处理切换 JDK。白天写代码，夜里写字，偶尔给某个人做一个只会发光的页面。Running models locally, compiling intent into rollback-safe execution chains, switching JDKs with a batch file. Code by day, writing at night, and once in a while a page that only glows for one person.
